description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “90 N Cartagena Carriage House”, A cozy, stylish retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach, perfect for couples or solo travelers seeking relaxation and adventure along Florida’s scenic 30A. This 1-bedroom, 1-bath carriage house offers everything you need for a comfortable stay, including a charming balcony, modern kitchen, and access to Rosemary’s private beach and luxurious pools. Hop on one of the included bikes and explore the cobblestone streets, local shops, and vibrant dining scene just minutes away. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Rosemary Beach Location — Enjoy private beach access and use of 4 beautiful community poolsPerfect for Couples — 1 spacious bedroom and inviting living spaces designed for relaxation2 Bikes Included — Cruise 30A’s scenic paths to explore the community and beyondModern Comforts — Stainless steel appliances, bar seating for 2, and a cozy living room with flat-screen TVCharming Balcony — Accessible from both the living area and bedroom for sipping morning coffee or evening cocktails*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into a bright and inviting living room where cozy furnishings and coastal charm create the perfect space to unwind. Large windows and glass doors open to a private balcony, seamlessly blending indoor comfort with the fresh Gulf breeze.Comfortable sofa and flat-screen TVBalcony off the living area for morning coffee or sunset drinks*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Prepare light bites or leisurely breakfasts in the well-appointed kitchen, designed for convenience and style.Stainless steel appliances including a gas rangeBar seating for 2 at the kitchen counter—perfect for casual meals or snacks*** BEDROOM & BATHROOM ***Unwind in the peaceful primary suite where soft linens and coastal decor create a restful retreat. Step onto the balcony to take in the quiet of Rosemary Beach or let in the fresh morning breeze.King bed with plush bedding and coastal touchesFlat-screen TV for relaxed eveningsPrivate balcony access from the bedroomEn-suite bathroom with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** OUTDOOR SPACES & COMMUNITY ***Enjoy the quiet charm of Rosemary Beach with access to luxurious amenities just moments from your door.Private balcony off the living area and bedroom for fresh-air loungingAccess to Rosemary Beach’s private community beachEnjoy four community pools, including the heated Sky Pool and family-friendly Cabana PoolTwo adult bikes included for easy exploration of 30A’s shops, restaurants, and scenic trails*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during the reservation process or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to use the 2 included bikes; additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not permitted in Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach or Seacrest BeachStreet parking is available to carriage house guests with a visible Rosemary Beach parking pass and is first come, first serve. The spaces in front of the garage are for main house guests only.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 83926STRO #: STR-221798

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
